name: Takanashi Mio
source:
-Kusunoki Obstetrics and Gynecology Nurse
--Single
-No experience with men
-Serious and hardworking
∙-Reckless

Because of her strong-willed personality, she resists against the killer, but this makes him mad and he makes her the first object of his amusement.
